name: Trump International Hotel & Tower Chicago
positioning: Downtown Chicago skyscraper hotel on the Chicago River near the Magnificent Mile, with a rooftop restaurant, a riverside bar and a spa
best_for: Extended stays that need a kitchen, since every suite has one
Travelers who want river and skyline views in downtown Chicago

facts.text: The building is one of the tallest reinforced concrete buildings in the world.
The hotel sits along the Chicago River, with views of Navy Pier and its weekly seasonal fireworks show.
The hotel is located near the Magnificent Mile.
Conde Nast Traveler calls it Chicago's tallest hotel, with views of the Chicago River and skyline.
Guest rooms and suites have custom designed furnishings and floor-to-ceiling windows.
The hotel offers its signature Trump Attache service.
Terrace 16 serves a seasonal New American menu.
Rebar, on the Mezzanine level, offers dining and cocktails along the Chicago River.
The Spa at Trump overlooks the Chicago skyline.
The hotel features the Anthony Cristiano Salon.
The spa offers treatments for individuals and couples.
For events, the hotel has a Grand Ballroom, Salon Rooms and Boardrooms.

highlights.text: The hotel says the building served as the inspiration for the Burj Khalifa and was designed by the mind behind that Dubai tower.
Terrace 16 is a rooftop restaurant on the 16th floor, with an indoor bar and dining room and an outdoor terrace overlooking the Chicago River, Lake Michigan and the city's architecture.
Terrace 16 offers views of Chicago's summer fireworks over the river on Wednesdays and Saturdays.
Rebar serves Neo Japanese fare created by Kamehachi, with views of the Chicago River and the Michigan Avenue Bridge.
Every suite has a fully equipped kitchen.

considerations.text: Terrace 16 asks guests to observe a business and chic casual dress code.
Guests must be 16 or older to use the Fitness Club, and guests under 16 must be accompanied by an adult to use the pool.
WhataHotel notes a busy downtown location with urban noise.
